_instructions: Physical codes copied from measured pc/deck_map.json. USB interface 0 must already use WinUSB. This map does not reprogram the keyboard.
E -> slot 1; B -> slot 2; Ctrl+Z -> slot 3; G -> approve; Ctrl+F -> deny; Space -> interrupt; hold H -> voice_down, release H -> voice_up; L (knob 1 press) -> screenshot.
Knob 1 clockwise S -> cycle +1, counterclockwise F -> cycle -1, press L -> screenshot.
Knob 2 clockwise R -> cycle +1, counterclockwise P -> cycle -1, press Q -> prompt tests.
Knob 3 clockwise - -> cycle +1, counterclockwise = -> cycle -1, press V -> prompt summary.
Knob 4 clockwise ] -> cycle +1, counterclockwise [ -> cycle -1, press Ctrl+0 -> prompt continue.
Slots 4..6 are available through HTTP or custom bindings. Only fresh single-key presses with exact device modifiers trigger actions. High-risk approvals need two presses within 1.5 seconds.

A string binding runs on key down. An object can bind down and up separately; up pairs with the accepted physical press even if modifiers change. Voice guards last at most 60 seconds; approvals and other window/input actions require releasing voice first.
